scope: Incremental navigation target selection/materialization and next-point projection.

mappings.coverage: complete bounded incremental point scan with explicit extra backing and exact distance arithmetic
mappings.qualification: These helpers produce path targets and a next-point projection. Larger51d7b0 steering,51e910/51f1b0 wandering and51b1f0 traversal/clearance tests remain unreconstructed by this module. Prepared records must preserve actual point/candidate backing at index==count when the original loop reaches it. The existence, initialization and lifetime of that extra backing in every live level remains unresolved. Authored validation never fabricates an unavailable sentinel row. Finite position/radius arithmetic and valid referenced adjacency connections are required; nonfinite arithmetic, malformed pointers and aliasing scan query with cursor storage are excluded. Next-point raw copies preserve all32-bit payloads, including NaN and signed zero. Existing routing diagnostic512860 remains an explicit service. No new native mapping is credited for existing distance/routing helpers; this fragment maps only the four new entry points. No new authored script-command use credit. Tests use parsed navigation records and synthetic runtime states, not full loaded-game simulations. Native x86 versus independent Python comparisons passed. Compiled C# replay and game playtesting have not run.
mappings.comparisonStatus: Original-PC comparisons passed; portable replay compile only.
